documents.title: M2V User Guide (PDF)
documents.description: The only authored document in the project's documentation tree so far — a user-facing overview of M2V.

documents.title: Documentation tree (mostly empty)
documents.description: Standard QI doc folders are scaffolded but empty: Business Documentation\, Technical Documentation\, Cheatsheets\, Implementation Log\, Meeting Minutes\, Session Summaries\. To be populated as the project matures.

documents.title: Claude Project Instructions
documents.description: What M2V is, its ports (API 8501 / UI 7841), family tier (cousin), the parallel-projects do-not-break table, and the session-start protocol pointing at the QI ecosystem files. Note: references the legacy C:\APPS\QI\ECOSYSTEM\ path; canonical location is C:\QIH\ecosystem\.

documents.title: README.md (not yet written)
documents.description: No root README exists yet. A top-level overview + quickstart is a high-priority documentation gap (see Future Enhancements).

documents.title: Main Entry Point
documents.description: Launches the FastAPI API (uvicorn, daemon thread) + Gradio UI. CLI: --api-only / --ui-only. Logs to data/logs/m2v.log.

documents.title: FastAPI App
documents.description: Endpoints on 8501: /health, /version, /info, POST /api/generate, /api/status/{id}(/events), /api/download/{id}, POST /api/extract-lyrics, /api/jobs. In-memory JOBS store; per-job daemon thread runs the pipeline.

documents.title: Pipeline Orchestrator
documents.description: run() — the five-stage generator (analyze lyrics -> segment audio -> generate clips -> assemble) that yields a progress dict per stage.

documents.title: Lyric Analyzer
documents.description: Splits lyrics into labelled segments (max 10), calls Ollama qwen3:8b for a visual prompt+mood+palette per scene, with a non-LLM fallback. Defines the Scene dataclass and 8 visual styles.

documents.title: Audio Analyzer
documents.description: Duration (librosa->mutagen->ffprobe->180s) and section timestamps (librosa MFCC agglomerative segmentation, even-split fallback).

documents.title: Lyrics Extractor
documents.description: ID3 USLT/SYLT + FLAC/MP4 lyric tags first, then Whisper transcription grouped into verse blocks. get_song_metadata() reads title/artist/album.

documents.title: Video Generator
documents.description: SDXL Base 1.0 (+ optional IP-Adapter) -> still, then Stable Video Diffusion -> motion clip, with alternating load/unload to fit 16GB VRAM. FFmpeg loops/scales the SVD output.

documents.title: Assembler
documents.description: FFmpeg concat of clips, audio mux with the original song, and burned-in SRT subtitles written from scene timings.

documents.title: Gradio UI
documents.description: The operator console: audio upload, lyric extraction, style picker, reference photo + strength, subtitle toggle, generate button, live progress log + video player. Polls /api/status/{id}/events.

documents.title: Forro MV builder (MoviePy)
documents.description: Self-contained renderer that turned scenes.json + the song MP3 into forro_anime_mv.mp4 (Ken Burns + crossfades + captions + placeholder fallback).

documents.title: ComfyUI frame generator
documents.description: stdlib urllib client that drives a running ComfyUI to produce the 10 anime key frames. Not yet run — the forro video currently uses placeholders.

documents.title: Storyboard
documents.description: 10-scene storyboard for 'Churrasco na Geórgia': resolution/fps, style_prefix, negative_prompt, per-scene start time, label, image, Portuguese caption, and SDXL prompt.

documents.title: Build log
documents.description: Evidence of the proof-of-concept render: 1920x1080 @ 30fps, 160.5s, completed in 706s using placeholder frames for all 10 scenes.

documents.title: Runtime Config
documents.description: Ports (api 8501 / ui 7841), pipeline defaults, Ollama settings, and backend defs. NOTE: backends (sdxl-turbo, CogVideoX) are stale vs the live engine (SDXL Base 1.0 + SVD).

documents.title: Config Loader
documents.description: Caches m2v.json, loads secrets/m2v.env if present, dotted-path get().

documents.title: Secrets Template
documents.description: Empty placeholder — M2V needs no external API keys (fully local).

documents.title: Service Installer
documents.description: Registers the QI_M2V NSSM Windows service (AppDirectory C:\APPS\M2V, runs main.py, logs to C:\APPS\M2V\logs\service.log). Not yet in QI_Service_Registry.md.

documents.title: Tunnel Installer
documents.description: Reference-only — carries a deprecation notice; M2V is now served by the static named tunnel qi-m2v (m2v.quiddityinnovations.com) managed at C:\QIH\engine\tunnels\.

documents.title: Startup / venv
documents.description: Start_M2V.bat runs main.py from .venv; setup_venv.py installs cu128 torch first then requirements.txt.

documents.title: Model Cache Cleanup
documents.description: Removes the abandoned sdxl-turbo from the HuggingFace cache; keeps SDXL Base 1.0, IP-Adapter, SVD.

documents.title: Smoke Tests
documents.description: pytest against :8501 (/health, /version, /info, /openapi.json); skips cleanly if the service is offline.

documents.title: QI Ecosystem Registry (m2v)
documents.description: M2V registry entry: id=m2v, status=new, family_tier=cousin, ports api 8501 / ui 7841, exposes /health /version /info, integrates_with empty.

documents.title: QI Ecosystem Map
documents.description: Port table, family map, and integration contracts for the whole QI ecosystem — where M2V sits among its siblings.

documents.title: Rendered Outputs
documents.description: Generated videos + subtitles from service-pipeline test runs (3 .mp4 + .srt pairs to date), plus forro_anime_mv.mp4 in the project root from the standalone PoC.

documents.title: Runtime Log
documents.description: Service launch log — confirms the API and Gradio UI started and answered /health on 2026-06-09 and 2026-06-10.
